newsitem.title: USA: US Senate panel votes for more CRP haying, grazing.
newsitem.headline: US Senate panel votes for more CRP haying, grazing.

text.p: Farmers and ranchers would be allowed to harvest hay and graze livestock on up to one-third of their Conservation Reserve land under legislation approved Wednesday by the U.S. Senate Agriculture Committee.
The provision was part of an agricultural research bill that was sent to the floor on a 16-0 vote.
Producers would have to accept a reduction in their annual Conservation Reserve payment commensurate to the value of the cover crop that was used.
Committee staff said the provison was expected to raise about $4 million a year and $20 million over five years.
